name: Smart Resto — W2 · Review Upload → Privacy → QR → Cloudinary → DB

nodes.name: Webhook — Review Submitted
nodes.notes:
Posted by: app/[locale]/r/[reservationId]/page.tsx (review form)
Payload: {
  reservationId, cafeId, cafeName, cafeLogoUrl, packageType,
  isArtisticQrPaid, customerPhone,
  reviewText, rating (1-5),
  imageBase64 (optional, data:image/...;base64,...),
  userConsentGranted (boolean)
}

nodes.name: IF — Consent Granted?
nodes.notes:
Output 0 (TRUE)  → consent given  → keep photo intact
Output 1 (FALSE) → no consent     → apply privacy filter via Python API

nodes.name: NoOp — Photo OK (Consent TRUE)
nodes.notes: Photo is untouched — user gave consent. Pass through.

nodes.name: HTTP — Privacy Blur API
nodes.notes:
Calls POST /process-image on our FastAPI QR microservice.
Parameters:
  image_base64 : the raw base64 from the review form
  mode         : 'privacy_blur' — applies Gaussian blur (radius 28) to the whole image
                 (For production: switch to 'face_blur' mode with AWS Rekognition face boxes)
  blur_radius  : 28 px (strong enough to anonymise)

Returns: { processed_image: 'data:image/png;base64,...' }

ADD THIS ENDPOINT to services/qr-generator/main.py:
  POST /process-image
  Body: { image_base64: str, mode: str, blur_radius: int }
  Returns: { processed_image: str }   (base64 PNG)

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM input1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM input2

nodes.name: Merge — Photo Ready
nodes.notes:
Reunites the TRUE (intact) and FALSE (blurred) branches.
  input1 receives TRUE branch items (NoOp)
  input2 receives FALSE branch items (Privacy Blur API)
Both branches carry the full review payload.

nodes.name: HTTP — QR Engine
nodes.notes:
Calls our FastAPI microservice at QR_ENGINE_URL.

Dynamic preview_mode logic:
  preview_mode = TRUE  when packageType === 'Free' AND isArtisticQrPaid === false
  preview_mode = FALSE when paid (6-Month / Annual) OR isArtisticQrPaid is true
  (already computed in 'Set — Parse Incoming Review' as qrPreviewMode)

Returns:
  { image: 'data:image/png;base64,...', brand_color: '#c0392b', preview_mode: true|false }

nodes.name: HTTP — Cloudinary Upload QR
nodes.notes:
Credentials: username = CLOUDINARY_API_KEY, password = CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
Returns: { secure_url, public_id, ... }
upload_preset 'smartresto_qr' must be created in Cloudinary dashboard
(Settings → Upload → Add upload preset → unsigned or signed)

nodes.name: IF — Has Review Photo?
nodes.notes:
Only upload review photo to Cloudinary if the customer actually attached one.
Output 0 (TRUE)  → upload photo
Output 1 (FALSE) → skip photo upload, pass null secure_url

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.value: =review_{{ $('Code — Merge QR + Review Data').first().json.cafeId }}_{{ $('Code — Merge QR + Review Data').first().json.reservationId }}

nodes.name: HTTP — Create ReviewGallery + Update Cafe
nodes.notes:
POST /api/v1/review-gallery (new Express route to add).
This route must:
  1. Create ReviewGallery document
  2. Increment cafe.totalReservationsCount
  3. Update cafe.logoAccentColor = brandColor (if provided)
  4. Return { reviewGalleryId }

nodes.name: HTTP — Notify Manager (Push)
nodes.notes:
Creates a SystemNotification in MongoDB so the manager sees a badge in the admin dashboard.
You can also add Slack / email here if needed.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, reviewGalleryId: $('HTTP — Create ReviewGallery + Update Cafe').first().json.reviewGalleryId }) }}

notes:
REQUIRED ENV VARS in n8n Settings → Variables:

  QR_ENGINE_URL          — e.g. http://qr-service:8000  (internal Coolify network)
  API_BASE_URL           — e.g. https://api.smartrestau.digima.cloud
  INTERNAL_API_SECRET    — long random string; set in Express as process.env.INTERNAL_API_SECRET
  CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME  — from cloudinary.com dashboard
  CLOUDINARY_API_KEY     — from cloudinary.com dashboard  (used as Basic Auth username)
  CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET  — from cloudinary.com dashboard  (used as Basic Auth password)

NEW EXPRESS ROUTE NEEDED:  POST /api/v1/review-gallery
Logic:
  1. prisma.reviewGallery.create({ data: { cafeId, reservationId, imageUrl, reviewText, rating, userConsentGranted, moderationStatus: 'pending' } })
  2. prisma.cafe.update({ where: { id: cafeId }, data: { totalReservationsCount: { increment: 1 }, logoAccentColor: brandColor || undefined } })
  3. prisma.systemNotification.create(...)
  4. return { reviewGalleryId }

FACE BLUR ENDPOINT (add to services/qr-generator/main.py):
  POST /process-image
  Body: { image_base64: str, mode: 'privacy_blur', blur_radius: int }
  Logic:
    img = Image.open(base64_to_bytes(image_base64))
    blurred = img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=blur_radius))
    return { processed_image: pil_to_base64(blurred) }
